model_change: Parameter and structure: sex-specific BMI anchor means and approximate SDs selected.
reason: Joint sex/BMI cells constrain the available predictor-outcome relationship directly.

model_change: Interpretation: kept adjusted coefficients separate from unadjusted cell means.
reason: Stacking Table 3 effects onto Table 2 means would double count associations and change the adjustment estimand.

model_change: Analysis qualification and assumed declining extrapolation.
reason: Shape search yielded an independent cross-country lead; its numerical supplement is unsupported PDF, so its content was not accessed.

model_change: No tuning to simulation draw; contrasted declining-tail and flat-tail conditional means.
reason: Both can agree at central anchors while differing materially at severe BMI; finite sensitivity pair is not a calibrated uncertainty interval.

model_change: Qualification: common age pattern provisional; no unsupported standardized-to-raw conversion.
reason: Dallas female standardized age coefficient differs from male; source age/HDL SDs for those models are missing.

model_change: Scale parameter derived as SE*sqrt(n), rather than mistakenly using SE as individual noise.
reason: Methods explicitly define reported plus/minus as SE. Numerical tests recover each assumed moment.

model_change: Distribution assumption: positive lognormal retained.
reason: No retrieved conditional quantiles identify a better tail family; marginal Dallas quantiles are not exact conditional checks.

model_change: Measurement/population qualifications; no target calibration.
reason: Source predictor distributions and compatible sampling/measurement operators are unavailable.

model_change: Use qualification only.
reason: Cross-sectional construction does not estimate causal interventions.

model_change: Initial model frozen pending independent review.
reason: Six queries and three downloads used; six queries and nine downloads reserved for an attainable review-triggered correction. This is pragmatic stopping, not exhaustive search saturation.

model_change: Evidence extraction and qualification only; exact generator/spec retained.
reason: F1: ledger now records all Table 5 age contrasts, p-values and Table 2 age/BMI cell counts; differences between individual estimates are not formal interaction tests.

model_change: No selected coefficient change; added focused pooled-versus-BMI-stratified age-contrast comparison.
reason: F1: shows the possible effect on age contrasts while keeping the source adjustment set and small underweight stratum visible.

model_change: No numerical change.
reason: Compatible age/sex/BMI search found a potentially useful article, but its maintext was rejected for excluded_study_alias. Do not use its rejected content; retain the simpler pooled-age scenario rather than assert a new raw slope.

model_change: Mean interpolation retained.
reason: F2: no joint within-cell predictor distributions obtained; source means cannot be reverse-engineered into a unique conditional model.

model_change: Clarified operator and variance accounting; no unsupported residual-variance deduction.
reason: F2: calculate variance from the explicit source-midpoint age mixture separately from within-cell SD, and label it as an assumed diagnostic rather than source replication.

model_change: Added within-obesity evidence and measurement/selection qualifications; numerical model unchanged.
reason: F3: followed concrete class-I/II/III leads; read Turkish Table 1 primary means/SDs; Mexican sex/class table is inaccessible PDF. The separate U.S. lead was rejected and supplied no maintext.

model_change: Added source-scale descriptive contrast; retained tail parameters.
reason: F3: class III minus I HDL mean is -5.24 mg/dL. Selected-sex plug-in contrasts are directionally compatible, but missing sex/joint distributions prevent an exact source model operator or numeric fit.

model_change: Same assumed tail asymptotes and decay retained; original flat alternative remains explicit.
reason: Continued decline remains plausible; small selected source does not justify re-estimating the target tail. This is a justified numerical no-op, not evidence of target accuracy.

model_change: Lognormal family retained.
reason: Reported mean/SD information cannot discriminate conditional tail families; no threshold calibration performed.

model_change: Population/assay qualification strengthened; no change to person-level random noise.
reason: Additional sources have substantial selection and measurement differences; neither identifies a U.S. transport offset.

model_change: No causal model added.
reason: Cross-sectional primary evidence does not identify intervention or aging responses.

model_change: Final numerical candidate frozen without parameter changes.
reason: Two focused review searches and four download attempts yielded two usable contextual sources and two rejections. Relevant available leads are assessed; no exhaustive saturation claimed. Total use 8 queries/7 downloads, below the cap.
